control_failures.control_label: proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for TX-3001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on TX-3001 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-3001 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 29 May 2020 a planned critical control verification of TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the proving zero energy before intrusive work not effective.
